flaws.locator: Proposition 2.22 (TeX label Nacycgroupoidprop), proof: 'Then inductively apply Lemma 2.21 [amalgamationlem] ... In each step as stated in the lemma, compatibility with corresponding chains implies that G* cannot have coset cycles of length up to N with cosets generated by sets of the form alpha beta_i where |alpha| <= 2k. For 2k = |E|, this rules out all coset cycles of length up to N' - the induction consumes Lemma 2.21 (i), G*_alpha isomorphic to G_alpha for |alpha| < 2k (the stabilisation), which the lemma's proof derives from the compatibility of completion with alpha'-reducts ('The alpha'-reducts of alpha'-connected components of its completion arise as substructures of the completions of merged chains of components of the form G_{alpha' alpha beta}, according to Lemma 2.9 [completionandsubgroupslem]'); the notice: 'completion turns out to be incompatible with restriction to proper subsets of the generator set, so that the induction towards Proposition 2.22 does not stabilise as claimed'

Moreover, such an I-groupoid can be chosen to be compatible with any given I-graph H.')

statement_status.reference: S-0071: 'the induction towards Proposition 2.22 does not stabilise as claimed. This problem has been overcome in arXiv:1806.08664' - the proof is withdrawn ('I know of no direct repair'); the proposition as stated is neither re-proved nor disproved by the notice, and the later paper (S-0072) reworks the construction and its concepts; the true reading (the result stands by the later paper) is named in RECORD.md as the alternative

notes: Route A item 36 (candidate 30), Session 21. Ground truth as the author's v5 withdrawal comment documents it, confirmed against the v4 text (Section 2.4 and Lemma 2.9; no corrected version of this paper exists) and against the author's later account in arXiv:1806.08664 (S-0072: 'the proposal of a naive completion operation accounts for the major flaw'; found by Julian Bitterlich in 2019); RECORD.md names FLAW-0004 as the alternative class and the true reading of the statement as the alternative. Lemmas 2.9 and 2.21 are not named by the notice and are not items (D2.3). v2's (2014, Lemma 2.9) and v4's (2015) own corrections are outside the window. A reading of documents, not a verdict on the paper (SD3).
